officialText:
Section 250.119 – Revise the Exception No. 1 in Section 250.119 to read as follows:

Exception No. 1: Power-limited Class 2 or Class 3 cables, or communications cables containing only circuits operating at less than 50 volts ac or 60 volts dc where connected to equipment not required to be grounded shall be permitted to use a conductor with green insulation or green with 1 or more yellow stripes for other than equipment grounding purposes.
